name: Open Bar
tagline: The CRM for people who work every Saturday so other people can get drunk and dance.
positioning: Open Bar is the client pipeline, contract, and payment system for wedding vendors who are sick of running their business from a phone at a reception.

hero.h1: Book the wedding. Not the paperwork.
hero.sub: Open Bar turns the chaos of inquiries, contracts, deposits, and day-of timelines into one pipeline you can actually run between shoots. Built for the vendor who is also the receptionist.

features.title: Inquiries that stop ghosting
features.description: Every DM, form, and referral lands in one inbox with reply templates and auto follow-ups, so the 11pm 'is our date open?' gets answered before they email your competitor.

features.title: Contracts and deposits in one tap
features.description: Send the proposal, the contract, and the deposit link as a single thing. They sign, they pay, you get a Saturday off from chasing invoices.

features.title: Day-of timelines that survive the day
features.description: Build the run-of-show once, share it with the couple and the other vendors, and stop being the person who knows when the cake actually shows up.

features.title: Booking calendar without double-books
features.description: See held dates, tentatives, and confirmed weddings in one view. No more accidentally selling June 14th twice.

features.title: Numbers you can trust
features.description: Revenue booked, deposits outstanding, and which season is quietly killing you — reported without a spreadsheet you forgot to update.

features.title: Vendor handoffs that don't lose a file
features.description: Share galleries, floor plans, and shot lists with planners and venues without a 40-message text thread.

testimonials.quote: I used to write contracts in my car after tastings. Open Bar sends the proposal, the deposit, and the timeline before the couple's parking meter runs out. I booked two extra weddings last fall just by replying faster.
testimonials.name: Renata Ozdemir

testimonials.quote: Wedding CRMs usually feel like they were built by someone who has never carried a light stand up three flights of stairs. This one didn't make me want to throw my laptop into a lake. High praise.
testimonials.name: Marcus Deel

testimonials.quote: The double-booking thing happened to me exactly once. It will not happen again. Open Bar just shows me the dates and the deposits, and I stopped losing sleep over a shared Google Sheet.
testimonials.name: Priya Vanterpool

pricing.blurb: For the one-person studio who is somehow also the accountant.
For growing shops with associates, second shooters, or a real assistant.
For multi-location venues and agencies running dozens of vendors.

homepage.footerBlurb: Open Bar is the CRM for wedding vendors who would rather be shooting, cooking, planning, or spinning — literally anything but paperwork.
